name: Vinsys IT Services India Ltd.
summary: Vinsys IT Services India Ltd. operates as a global provider of IT services and professional training and development. The company's primary offerings include corporate training and certifications in areas such as project management, IT security, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud computing, and application development. It also provides digital learning solutions, including learning management systems and custom content development. In addition, Vinsys offers a suite of software development services encompassing SaaS, cybersecurity, quality engineering, custom application development, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and managed IT services. The company extends its services to include AI-powered foreign language services, such as translation, localization, interpretation, and language training, as well as recruitment process outsourcing solutions. Vinsys also operates a business academy offering training in leadership, human resources, supply chain, and compliance. The company targets a broad range of clients, including corporates, academic institutions, and government bodies across diverse sectors such as automotive, telecommunications, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and BFSI. Its operations span India, Gulf countries, and the USA, serving over 4,000 organizations, including Fortune 500 companies. Vinsys is primarily focused on the Software & IT Services and Education and Training Services (B2B) industries.
